title: Lunar tank · liquid fields through 35 windows
field_note: 221 exact saved states selected from 3,022 native snapshots, up to seven per phase. No time interpolation. Values are native planar cells, not a 3D tank solve. Fraction display saturates tiny numerical overshoots at 0 and 1. Plots retain the full saved ledger; the cursor readout uses its nearest record and reports that timestamp.
source_note: Coarse 2D VOF with prescribed mission windows and separate one-way isothermal 0D helium inventory. CFD window time excludes long physical coasts. From phase 29 the simulated tank stays in lunar orbit; Orion return/entry is context, not solved LOX or aerothermal flow. No grid/time-step independence or physical validation.
